description: The final synthesized answer only asserts facts that are supported by one or more specialist outputs; it does not introduce facts absent from all specialist evidence (no hallucinations). This is assessed by checking that each factual assertion in final_answer_text has at least one matching evidence excerpt or specialist output in the run logs.

Every non-trivial factual claim in the final_answer_text is mapped to one or more specialist_id(s) in the provenance_map, and the mapping includes supporting evidence excerpts when available or a documented reason when evidence is absent. This is assessed from the provenance_map artifact and final_answer_text.

The synthesizer is invoked with the collected specialist results and applies a documented conflict-resolution strategy (e.g., majority, confidence-weighted, meta-critic). Contradictions among specialists are reconciled, summarized, or explicitly annotated rather than left as unresolved concatenation. Evidence: synthesize_results call parameters, applied_strategy, and final_answer_text showing reconciliation or explicit conflict annotations.

Specialist invocations show overlapping start_time and end_time intervals or simultaneous active handles indicating parallel execution rather than strictly serialized calls. Assessable via invocation records, max concurrency, and timestamp overlaps in the logs.

Any specialist with status TIMEOUT, ERROR, or MALFORMED is recorded in the final artifacts (e.g., excluded_specialists or provenance_map) with a clear reason; failures are not silently ignored. Assessable via run_specialist return payloads and the final excluded_specialists/provenance artifacts.

The agent honors the declared timeout_policy (e.g., wait_for_all, wait_until_T, incorporate_late_if_better), meets scenario time-to-first-answer and time-to-final-answer thresholds when required, and documents any trade-offs between latency and completeness. Assessable via timestamps, synthesis_time_ms, and declared timeout_policy in aggregator parameters.

When specialists return malformed outputs or late-but-higher-quality results, the synthesizer detects and either repairs/normalizes malformed outputs with justification or incorporates/excludes late responses according to the declared policy and documents the decision. Evidence: raw_output shapes, timestamps, synthesis_time_ms, excluded_specialists, and final_answer_text rationale.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
